judge.voice: Honestly, I got to talk about a proper topic and Sam's questions were at my level, which I liked. The help buttons are easy to find. But the first help just made the question simpler, which is a bit babyish for B2, and the phrase quiz had an option about using it at night. That is not a real choice. Then I finished and got no note about what I actually said, and no chance to try again, which was the whole point. I even asked whether my sentence was correct; the answer was yes, fine, but I'd like the rule or one thing to improve. I can't tell what I should fix, so my tutor still has to re-check me. I might use it for the conversation, but not yet as a replacement for my weekly tutor.
